name: Satyrnaar
summary: Satyrnaar lies in ruin under the Bleakheart satyrs in northeastern Ashenvale. The ancient night elf settlement sits beside the road from Splintertree Post toward Azshara, intact enough to be one of the forest’s easiest satyr strongholds to reach.

sections.title: A Den of Fel and Shadow
sections.body: You find Satyrnaar northeast of Splintertree Post and southwest of Forest Song, among Ashenvale’s three chief satyr settlements with Xavian and Night Run. Its elven buildings remain more intact than those deep in the wilderness, though tents now stand among the broken stone. The Bleakheart satyrs occupy the camp, making the trade road east toward Azshara dangerous for travelers. They have also allied with the Cult of the Dark Strand, whose soulgem lies among the corrupted stones.

faq.answer: Satyrnaar lies in ruin in northeastern Ashenvale, occupied by the Bleakheart satyrs. It is one of their chief strongholds in the forest.
The Bleakheart satyrs occupy Satyrnaar, with tents among the ancient ruins. They are allied with the Cult of the Dark Strand.

faq.q: Why is Satyrnaar significant compared to other satyr ruins?
faq.answer: Satyrnaar, Night Run, and Xavian are Ashenvale’s three chief satyr settlements. Satyrnaar is the most intact and lies beside the road toward Azshara.

faq.q: What is the dark artifact hidden in Satyrnaar?
faq.answer: A soulgem of the Cult of the Dark Strand lies in Satyrnaar. The mortal shadow cult is allied with the Bleakheart satyrs.

angles.text: As a night elf, seeing ancestral stonework defiled by fel corruption and occupied by the cursed remnants of the Highborne is a bitter sight in Ashenvale.
As a druid, you see how the Bleakheart satyrs’ fel corruption chokes Ashenvale’s natural spirit, calling for swift cleansing.
